top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four caregiver's records evaluated were missing one hour of child maltreatment training.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §744.2601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff did not conduct a full walkthrough of the environment to ensure that there were no risks to children before the children arrived. A steak knife was found in a box. During the investigation inspection follow up the operation met compliance as there were no steak knives in a box located on a table accessible to children in the cafeteria. Children didn't have access to safety hazards in the cafeteria.  located on a table accessible to children in the cafeteria.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training (26 TAC §744.1317(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Proof of 2 hours of transportation safety training needed for three drivers.
